en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding a husband who died and left a wife. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For her is the quarter, and hand over the remainder to us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Musa ibn Bakr from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “About the case of a man who dies and leaves behind his wife, abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One-fourth belongs to her and the rest must be given to us.’”
